summary: Zentek Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the engagement of IMPAQ Capital Inc. for investor relations services. IMPAQ will receive a monthly cash fee of C$13,500 for a six-month term with automatic renewals. No securities are issued to IMPAQ. The filing does not involve any M&A, restructuring, or other special situation; it is a routine service contract to broaden investor awareness. No deal terms are applicable as this is not a transaction.
